ordinary_boot_scope: Disposable SDK ramdisk patch, cold boot, setup, cold boot preserving userdata, instrumentation, hidden create/restore and native crash checks. These are ordinary boot-image fixtures, not physical-device Direct Install or OTA claims.

supplemental_scope.authentication_shared_uid_profile_action: e3c3a6231 release on enforcing API 35. Shared UID/profile fixtures used the explicit MagiskSU endpoint to isolate policy; their initial ordinary-PATH failure led to the separate-partition fix and the independent plain-application RootPathTest.
supplemental_scope.hidden_upgrade: Owned 978b05406 release stub revision 41, then 7adc6aa34 release payload. The same generated signer updated the stub to revision 42 and the preferences launcher worked.
supplemental_scope.rootless_recovery: 684a8fc73 release payload on the held API 35 VM. Stock ramdisk preserved userdata and removed the Magisk daemon. Android install and uninstall confirmations restored the full app with default preferences; a patched cold boot restored canonical-manager root recognition.
supplemental_scope.concurrency: 240 requests, 12 workers, actual client UID 2000, with 21 concurrent SQL cache invalidations on the 2bbdffac native core; native source is unchanged in the later app fixes.
supplemental_scope.gms_guard: 6e9b44123 debug on a separate unprivileged API 35 ATD. A differently signed user GMS fixture was rejected; explicitly loading its provider was the positive control. The production guard is unchanged in subsequent candidates.

mumu.target: Android Device-1, MuMu Pro on Apple Silicon, Android API 32 arm64, permissive SELinux
mumu.qualification: Fresh external backup, five identical stable-target descriptions, both init-domain probes, persistence and exact restore challenges passed.
lifecycle: Hide/SuList pending read-only UI and cold-boot mode application
complete managed uninstall and cold boot
manager/core/overlay absent after uninstall; policy database, module/script directories and unrelated sentinel remained
mumu.lab_failures: Earlier qualification attempts failed closed on a target-description mismatch or transport closure. An orphan from one failed attempt was removed by its exact UUID before a fresh qualification. The final wrapper disconnected stale ADB transport, required a new boot ID and checked root readiness; no qualification check was relaxed.

regressions.su_launcher: Eight controlled app_process launches with inherited blocked signals exited 139; eight with a cleared mask exited 0. Child-only signal reset and repeated consent tests close the failure.
regressions.policy_cache: Mutex-protected Arc cloning/publication prevents concurrent cache invalidation from freeing an Arc before a reader owns it.
regressions.path_exposure: The mount engine rejects missing children directly beneath a separate partition root. Candidate selection now skips those paths, while retaining protected nested-directory injection on the qualified MuMu layout.
regressions.hidden_navigation: Single-task self-relaunch closed the hidden launcher; recreation and explicit destination state replace it. Optional pin-shortcut prompts no longer cover requested navigation.
regressions.stub_upgrade: Revision-41 upgrade initially rendered before the root service connected and crashed on the main thread. Initialization now completes before the upgrade is requested from the initialized activity.
regressions.legacy_sqlite: Consent persistence uses atomic INSERT OR REPLACE with preserved notification/log flags; no unsupported UPSERT syntax.
regressions.migration: A root-authorized nonce binds target UID, sender package/UID/certificate and single-use consumption. Existing security-preference migration exclusions remain. Unauthenticated extras cannot import preferences or trigger migration cleanup.
regressions.legacy_install_source: The installer no longer invokes REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES appops before API 26. API 24 x86 exposed a native Binder shutdown crash in that unnecessary command after successful installation; the actual shell function is tested across API 23–26 and installation failures, and the native-crash gate remains enabled.
regressions.instrumentation_identity: Only instrumentation signed with the full manager identity is eligible for hidden repackaging; an APK name alone is not trust.

limits: System Mode remains experimental and debug-only.
No physical phone, real OTA, recovery ZIP or OEM-specific qualification is inferred from these emulator results.

PR14 retains module and early-mount closure; PR15 repeats full lifecycles on exact additional targets and phones; PR16 owns production signing, historical certificate transition and release promotion.
Historical Full/Lite publisher assets are provenance, not automatically trusted migration payloads.

cleanup.final_avd_artifact_and_key_cleanup: Required before task completion; no generated APK or private signing key belongs in the repository.
